{{Quote|It was a droid that sent Rasper on his way.''"<br />"''A lucky droid, a luckier shot.|Boiny and a female Rodian mercenary|<ref name="cod" />}}
'''Rasper''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who worked with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]]'s team in the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]]. In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref>, Rasper was part of the group of Nebula Front members led by Cohl in infiltrating the ''[[Revenue]]'', a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]] that was receiving a shipment of [[Lommite/Legends|lommite ore]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]]. He was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] at the beginning of their mission.<ref name="cswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
